study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized cortical thickness asymmetry in Autism Spectrum Disorders and Schizophrenia

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Datasets explicitly named include ABIDE-I/II, BGS, COBRE, Utrecht (main text) and CAMCAN, IXI, OASIS, ROCKLAND, AOMIC-ID1000/PIOP1/PIOP2, DLBS, NARRATIVES, SALD, MITASD, WASHASD, MADRID-ASD (supplemental table). Items without a matching minor category are captured under Unknown; OASIS version not specified (mapped to OASIS-1).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II datasets include low quality T1 data... The BGS and COBRE datasets have undergone extensive quality control procedures... For the Utrecht dataset images also underwent extensive quality control"; "| CAMCAN | ... | IXI | ... | OASIS | ... | ROCKLAND |"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Echave2024.pdf.md: Methods / Image processing and quality control, L81-L82; Echave2024_sup.docx.md: Supplemental Table 2

answer.Clinical datasets (ASD/SZ) with controls: 90% of healthy controls to training and 10% to HCtest; all cases to test

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The paper describes how datasets are split based on whether they include only healthy controls or include cases; dataset-specific purpose assignments are not enumerated.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "For each of the datasets exclusively comprising healthy controls 90% of individuals went into the training set and 10% into the test set (HCtest)... From each of the clinical datasets... 90% of the healthy controls were added to the training set and 10% were added to the HCtest. All cases with ASD or SZ were added to the test set."
